About Us

Overwolf is the world’s leading platform for in-game creators and gamers who build or consume user-generated content around their favorite games. We’re talking about some of the biggest AAA titles out there – games like Minecraft, League of Legends, World of Warcraft, PUBG, and Fortnite – to name a few.

The way people create and play games worldwide is changing, and Overwolf is leading the revolution. We empower just about Loading...K creators to make the best games even better - giving them everything they need to create unique gaming experiences that serve more than Loading...M gamers every month.

Our mission is to turn in-game creation into a new profession and build the next generation of games. And we’re just getting started.

Are you ready to join the pack and shape the future of gaming?
